propositions: Add a new directional link relation `caused_by` to express causal provenance of bugs ("this bug was caused by that ticket/change") as a first-class graph edge.
The `caused_by` relation must be added to the hardcoded non-blocking tuple at line ~204 in `src/rebar/graph/_graph.py` or it will incorrectly receive blocking-cycle semantics.
The change is additive and follows the `discovered_from` precedent: directional, non-blocking, non-cycle-inducing, Jira-unmapped, and does not require rewriting persisted LINK events.
The relation string must be duplicated across schema, generated types, _links.py, _graph.py tuple, unlink.py, help text, and golden CLI-help snapshots for enforcement and documentation consistency.
A dedicated `caused_by` relation (not reused from `discovered_from`) is required so recovery-time and source-of-bugs analysis can traverse causation directly with distinct semantics.
Backward compatibility is maintained: old LINK events without the relation continue to reduce without error and the full test suite validates non-cycle and non-blocking behaviors.
